name: Hormilla (Spain)
description: Square green flag with a yellow triangle with its base along the hoist and its apex at the middle of the fly, charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Hormilla (a tower and a bunch of grapes on green and yellow).
history: Municipal flag of Hormilla; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.
